text: Which relation is the canonical commutator that underlies the entire ladder-operator algebra of quantum optics?
explanation: The bosonic commutator [a, a-dagger] = 1 generates the ladder structure. Choice 1 would make the operators commute (no ladder); i*hbar (choice 2) is the position-momentum commutator, not the dimensionless ladder relation; the anticommutator (choice 3) applies to fermions, not photonic modes.
